cues.en: Mike: All right, now let's check out how to implement a logistic regression in code, starting off with MATLAB.
cues.zh: Mike：現在看看如何實作邏輯斯迴歸，先從 MATLAB 開始。

cues.en: Here, I generate the data, so the columns are pass or fail.
cues.zh: 這裡產生資料，欄位包含及格或不及格。

cues.en: So you can see I've organized these data already so that all of the students who failed are in the first 10, so the first part of the dataset, and then it's all the students who passed.
cues.zh: 已經把資料整理成前 10 位、資料集前半，全部不及格，接著全部及格。

cues.en: And then the second column is the study hours, and the third column is the sleep hours.
cues.zh: 第二欄是讀書時數，第三欄是睡眠時數。

cues.en: And then just doing a little bit of plotting here.
cues.zh: 這裡做一點繪圖。

cues.en: Now, because these are paired data, so each student has two data points here, one for studying and one for sleeping.
cues.zh: 因為是配對資料，每位學生有兩個資料點，一個讀書、一個睡眠。

cues.en: So I'm drawing lines between them just to illustrate that.
cues.zh: 因此用線連起來，示意配對。

cues.en: Okay, so now for the logistic regression.
cues.zh: 接著邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: So it's a little bit similar, in some sense, to the ways of setting up a regression model that you've seen in the previous videos.
cues.zh: 某種程度上，與前幾支影片設定迴歸模型的方法相似。

cues.en: For example, multiple regression.
cues.zh: 例如多元迴歸。

cues.en: So I'm using this fitglm function, and that works by inputting a data table, a model specification, and then the distribution type.
cues.zh: 用 fitglm，輸入資料表、模型規格，以及分布類型。

cues.en: So we're using a binomial distribution, that's what we use for a logistic regression.
cues.zh: 使用二項分布，邏輯斯迴歸用這個。

cues.en: So the data table is just the data, and then it's converted into a MATLAB table data type.
cues.zh: 資料表就是原始資料，再轉成 MATLAB table 型別。

cues.en: So let's see what D looks like.
cues.zh: 看看 D。

cues.en: This is all the data that I already showed you above, and it also has the labels, the column labels up here at the top.
cues.zh: 全部資料先前已展示，也有上面的欄位標籤。

cues.en: Then we have the model specification.
cues.zh: 接著是模型規格。

cues.en: So this is a format that I've introduced you to before in a previous video.
cues.zh: 這個格式，先前影片介紹過。

cues.en: I think that was also in the video on multiple regression.
cues.zh: 我想也是多元迴歸那支。

cues.en: Now, before, it was, you know, it was a little bit more something like this, where I say the outcome variable is modeled as these two variables.
cues.zh: 先前比較像這樣，結果變數以這兩個變數建模。

cues.en: Now, when you input a model specification like this, MATLAB is automatically going to see the asterisk and interpret that to mean
cues.zh: 輸入這種規格，MATLAB 會看到星號，自動解讀為

cues.en: that you want the two main effects and their interaction.
cues.zh: 兩個主效應與交互作用。

cues.en: But in this case, we actually don't want the interaction.
cues.zh: 但這裡不想要交互作用。

cues.en: I'm not modeling the interaction between sleep and study, so therefore we say minus the interaction between sleep and study.
cues.zh: 不對睡眠與讀書交互作用建模，所以減去 sleep 與 study 的交互作用。

cues.en: So this doesn't mean, like, a minus sign, like we're subtracting the interaction or making it a negative interaction, this means we're actually removing the interaction term
cues.zh: 不是把交互作用的數值相減，或變成負交互作用，而是從模型規格中

cues.en: from the model specification.
cues.zh: 移除交互作用項。

cues.en: So that's this variable here.
cues.zh: 就是這個變數。

cues.en: So we get this model, and we can run this code here, and here are the results.
cues.zh: 取得模型，執行程式碼，這是結果。

cues.en: So we get the table, this shows that we're using a logit, or logistic regression, and it's modeled as an intercept plus study plus sleep.
cues.zh: 表格顯示使用 logit，也就是邏輯斯迴歸，模型是截距加 study 加 sleep。

cues.en: So, and here's the coefficients.
cues.zh: 這裡是係數。

cues.en: This is what I showed in the slides.
cues.zh: 就是投影片展示的。

cues.en: So we get a significant effect of sleep, and no real effect of study.
cues.zh: 睡眠效果顯著，讀書沒有真正效果。

cues.en: So we have 20 observations and 17 degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 有 20 筆觀察、17 個自由度。

cues.en: I'm sure you were able to figure that out in the previous video, because it's N minus K.
cues.zh: 相信上一支影片就能算出，因為是 N 減 K。

cues.en: So we have three parameters, so the intercept, study, and sleep, and 20 observations, so the degrees of freedom for each parameter are three.
cues.zh: 三個參數：截距、讀書、睡眠，以及 20 筆觀察，所以各參數的自由度是 3。

cues.en: Okay, so, let's see.
cues.zh: 好，看看。

cues.en: So now I'm gonna compute the model accuracy.
cues.zh: 接著計算模型準確率。

cues.en: So I'm gonna extract out of this model the predicted value.
cues.zh: 從模型取出預測值。

cues.en: So that's model.predict.
cues.zh: 也就是 model.predict。

cues.en: And this gives us the actual probabilities.
cues.zh: 得到實際機率。

cues.en: So the logistic regression model is saying that this individual has a 10% probability of passing,
cues.zh: 邏輯斯迴歸認為，這個人及格機率為 10%，

cues.en: so that means a 90% chance of failing.
cues.zh: 也就是不及格機率 90%。

cues.en: So that's the prediction for that individual.
cues.zh: 這是對他的預測。

cues.en: And then, here, I'm computing the overall accuracy, and that is the binarization and averaging of the first 10 values being less than 50%.
cues.zh: 這裡計算整體準確率，將前 10 個值是否小於 50% 二元化，再平均。

cues.en: So these should all be ones, and the fact that there's two zeros here means that there were two cases where the model made the wrong prediction.
cues.zh: 應該全為 1，兩個 0 表示模型有兩次預測錯誤。

cues.en: And then, same thing here.
cues.zh: 這裡同樣。

cues.en: We expect these individuals to have a data probability value of larger than 0.5.
cues.zh: 預期這些人的機率大於 0.5。

cues.en: So then I just take the average of that, and add up these two together.
cues.zh: 取平均，再把兩部分加起來。

cues.en: So this is the average accuracy for the people who actually failed, and this is the average accuracy for people who passed.
cues.zh: 這是不及格者的平均準確率，這是及格者的平均準確率。

cues.en: And then we average those together, and that gives us our overall accuracy of 75%.
cues.zh: 再把兩者平均，得到整體準確率 75%。

cues.en: Here I'm doing some plotting, and this is, you know, what I showed in the slide.
cues.zh: 這裡做繪圖，就是投影片的內容。

cues.en: So I'm plotting the predicted values of the model, which is actually the probability of passing, and then, by the individual.
cues.zh: 依個體，畫模型預測值，也就是及格機率。

cues.en: So again, all the first 10 individuals failed.
cues.zh: 前 10 個人全部不及格。

cues.en: The next 10 individuals passed.
cues.zh: 後 10 個人及格。

cues.en: So this would mean accurate classification, data points in here are accurate classification, and these five points here are misclassification.
cues.zh: 這裡資料點是正確分類，這裡也是，而這五個點是錯誤分類。

cues.en: So that gives us our overall accuracy of 75%.
cues.zh: 整體準確率是 75%。

cues.en: I'm going to use the logistic regression function that comes from the scikit-learn toolbox.
cues.zh: 使用 scikit-learn 工具箱中的邏輯斯迴歸函式。

cues.en: So let's start by generating the data.
cues.zh: 先產生資料。

cues.en: Here we have all the individuals, and first I'm listing the individuals who failed.
cues.zh: 列出所有個體，先列不及格者。

cues.en: And then we have all the individuals who passed the exam, and then how much time, how many hours they spent studying, and how many hours they spent sleeping.
cues.zh: 再列及格者，以及讀書與睡眠各花幾小時。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And then the rest of this code here is just plotting the data.
cues.zh: 其餘程式碼只是畫資料。

cues.en: And because these data come from the same individuals, then I'm showing them here with lines in between them, just so you can see where the pairs are.
cues.zh: 因為來自相同個體，所以用線連接，讓你看到配對。

cues.en: Okay, so now we do the logistic regression.
cues.zh: 接著做邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: So we use this LogisticRegression function to create a model object, and then, here, I create the design matrix.
cues.zh: 用 LogisticRegression 建立模型物件，再建立設計矩陣。

cues.en: So our design matrix has the two independent variables.
cues.zh: 設計矩陣有兩個自變數。

cues.en: Notice I'm not explicitly adding an intercept term, because the logistic regression model will add that for us.
cues.zh: 注意，沒有明確加入截距，因為模型會代勞。

cues.en: And I'm also not adding an interaction term, just because we're not interested in the interaction here.
cues.zh: 也沒加入交互作用，因為這裡不感興趣。

cues.en: Okay, so then we fit this model object with the input data, or the input being the design matrix and the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 以輸入資料擬合模型物件，也就是設計矩陣與依變數。

cues.en: And then I'm going to just plot a few of the results of this logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 接著列出幾個模型結果。

cues.en: In particular, the intercept and the coefficients.
cues.zh: 尤其截距與係數。

cues.en: So these are the coefficients for the two parameters that we have.
cues.zh: 這是兩個參數的係數。

cues.en: So now we can compute, we can predict the values here, by using logregmodel.predict, and we can also get the actual probability values.
cues.zh: 用 logregmodel.predict 預測數值，也能取得實際機率值。

cues.en: So this is gonna be the category labels, whether they passed or failed, or whether the model predicts that they passed or failed.
cues.zh: 這是類別標籤，及格或不及格，也就是模型預測是否及格。

cues.en: And these are the actual probability values here.
cues.zh: 這裡是實際機率值。

cues.en: So predict probability, okay?
cues.zh: 也就是 predict probability。

cues.en: And then print those out.
cues.zh: 把它們印出來。

cues.en: And so we see this is a binary label here, so this would be the model predicts that this student failed, that this student failed.
cues.zh: 這裡是二元標籤，模型預測這位不及格、這位不及格。

cues.en: The model actually predicts that this student passed, which we know is an error, because the first 10 numbers here should all be zeros.
cues.zh: 這位卻預測及格，我們知道錯了，因為前 10 個數字都應為 0。

cues.en: Okay, so in fact, these two should match.
cues.zh: 這兩者應該吻合。

cues.en: These are the predicted class labels, and these are the actual class labels.
cues.zh: 這是預測類別標籤，這是實際類別標籤。

cues.en: So anytime these two arrays diverge from each other, that is an error in prediction.
cues.zh: 兩個陣列任何不一致的地方，就是預測錯誤。

cues.en: Okay, and then these are the actual probability values.
cues.zh: 這些是實際機率值。

cues.en: So you see they're a little bit more graded.
cues.zh: 可以看到，更有程度上的差別。

cues.en: So the model actually predicts here with 73% probability that this first student failed,
cues.zh: 模型認為第一位學生不及格機率為 73%，

cues.en: and 26% probability that this student passed.
cues.zh: 及格機率為 26%。

cues.en: So obviously this number is bigger than this number, so therefore, the model gives a binarized prediction of failure.
cues.zh: 這個數字顯然較大，所以模型二元預測為不及格。

cues.en: Okay, so now, we can see that the overall average accuracy was 0.7.
cues.zh: 整體平均準確率是 0.7。

cues.en: That seems a little strange, because the data that I showed in the previous video, in the slides, had an accuracy of 0.75.
cues.zh: 有點奇怪，上一支影片投影片的資料，準確率是 0.75。

cues.en: So it turns out that there are multiple different solvers, multiple different algorithms that you can use in a logistic regression.
cues.zh: 邏輯斯迴歸其實可以使用多種求解器、不同演算法。

cues.en: And getting into the details of these different solvers is a little bit beyond the scope of what I'd like to get into in this discussion.
cues.zh: 不同求解器的細節，有點超過這裡想討論的範圍。

cues.en: But I do just wanna show you that the Newton method tends to work a little bit better for these binary logistic regression problems.
cues.zh: 但想示範，這種二元邏輯斯迴歸問題，牛頓法通常效果稍好。

cues.en: So I'm gonna run this again.
cues.zh: 再執行一次。

cues.en: And now that actually changed the values here.
cues.zh: 這裡的數值改變了。

cues.en: The coefficients changed and the intercept changed.
cues.zh: 係數與截距改變。

cues.en: And then we can see what the accuracy was here, and now we get 75%, and that's consistent with what I showed in the slides.
cues.zh: 再看準確率，現在是 75%，與投影片一致。

cues.en: Okay, and then here we do a little bit of plotting.
cues.zh: 接著做一點繪圖。

cues.en: This is the graph that I showed towards the end of the previous video.
cues.zh: 這是上一支影片結尾的圖。

cues.en: So just a quick reminder, these are the first 10 individuals who failed the exam, these are the guys who passed the exam, and these on the Y axis are the probability of passing.
cues.zh: 快速提醒，前 10 人考試不及格，這些人及格，Y 軸是及格機率。

cues.en: So these should all be less than 0.5, these should all be greater than 0.5.
cues.zh: 這些應小於 0.5，這些應大於 0.5。

cues.en: So these two points here are errors, these are misclassifications, and these three are also misclassifications.
cues.zh: 這兩點是錯誤分類，這三點也是。

cues.en: And that's how we get a total accuracy of 75%.
cues.zh: 因此總準確率是 75%。
